Moments use TorchAO quantized blocks (codes, scales and lookup maps); tensors smaller than4096 elements or not divisible by block_size retain parameter-dtype moments. optimizer_experiment.learning_rate_compatibility: Sprint float LR assignments fill TorchAO's existing CPU tensor in place, preserving the same numerical schedule without replacing the tensor.
